module: HP Networking Switches with VPN Firewall
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode with tamper evident labels and opacity shields installed as indicated in the Security Policy
description: HP Networking Box Switches are focused on enterprise access and aggregation application or datacenter applicationan are suitable for a range of uses: at the edge of a network, connecting server clusters in a data center, in an enterprise LAN core, and in large-scale industrial networks and campus networks. The series includes modular Ethernet switches. Each device is based on the Comware 5.2 platform.

labs: Leidos Accredited Testing & Evaluation (AT&E) Lab; SAIC-VA
